# Calculate the average ratio of high-calorie to combined low+moderate consumption

# Plot area: x from 129 to 977, so width = 848 pixels = 100%
plot_width = 977 - 129  # 848 pixels

# Data from color detection (x1, x2 for each segment)
# Format: (low_end, moderate_end, high_end) - all relative to plot start at x=129
categories = {
    "Fast Food": {"low": 467-129, "mod": 722-468, "high": 977-723},
    "Candy and Snacks": {"low": 425-129, "mod": 637-425, "high": 977-638},
    "Soft Drinks": {"low": 382-129, "mod": 552-383, "high": 977-553},
    "Pizza": {"low": 340-129, "mod": 552-341, "high": 977-553},
    "Sandwiches": {"low": 297-129, "mod": 552-298, "high": 977-553},
    "Burgers": {"low": 382-129, "mod": 595-383, "high": 977-596},
    "Fries": {"low": 340-129, "mod": 595-341, "high": 977-596},
    "Chicken Wings": {"low": 255-129, "mod": 467-256, "high": 977-468},
    "Pasta Dishes": {"low": 297-129, "mod": 552-298, "high": 977-553},
    "Vegetable Plates": {"low": 212-129, "mod": 382-213, "high": 977-383},
}

# Convert to percentages
for cat in categories:
    low_pct = categories[cat]["low"] / plot_width * 100
    mod_pct = categories[cat]["mod"] / plot_width * 100
    high_pct = categories[cat]["high"] / plot_width * 100
    categories[cat]["low_pct"] = low_pct
    categories[cat]["mod_pct"] = mod_pct
    categories[cat]["high_pct"] = high_pct
    categories[cat]["ratio"] = high_pct / (low_pct + mod_pct)

# Print results
print("Category breakdown (percentages):")
print("-" * 80)
for cat, data in categories.items():
    print(f"{cat:20s}: Low={data['low_pct']:.2f}%, Mod={data['mod_pct']:.2f}%, High={data['high_pct']:.2f}%, Ratio={data['ratio']:.3f}")

# Calculate average ratio
ratios = [data["ratio"] for data in categories.values()]
avg_ratio = sum(ratios) / len(ratios)

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print(f"Average ratio of High to (Low + Moderate): {avg_ratio:.4f}")
print(f"Individual ratios: {ratios}")
print(f"Sum of ratios: {sum(ratios):.4f}")
